description: Create a link that lets a person connect one of their accounts (e.g. google-search-console) to this organization without an Anaella login. Give them the url; when they finish, their browser returns to returnUrl with ?status=connected&channelId=… (or ?status=error&code=…). returnUrl must be on an origin allowed under Settings → API keys → Connect. Links work once, for 30 minutes. To call the connected account afterwards use do with a typed capability (e.g. gsc.queries.list).
